tasks.objective: Implement the tamper-evident chain core in a new app/audit.py: entry hashing per C1 (sha256 over canonical JSON of {id, prev_entry_hash}, GENESIS marker), and a verify() function that takes a list of stored items (oldest-first), recomputes every entry_hash, checks every link (entry[i].prev_entry_hash == entry[i-1].entry_hash), and returns a structured result {status: 'ok'|'broken'|'unanchored_head', first_broken_link, head: {event_id, anchored}} without raising on broken chains. Unit tests in tests/test_audit_core.py cover: unmodified chain verifies anchored at GENESIS; a rewritten middle entry is detected at its link; a mid-removed entry is detected at the dangling link.

concepts: sha256 over canonical JSON (json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')))
hash-chain link invariant (prev pointer of entry i equals entry_hash of entry i-1)
genesis anchoring and the unanchored-head state after overwrite (A1/A2 semantics)

tasks.objective: Integrate the audit chain into the existing EventAPI in app/events.py: post_event reads the buffer's current newest item, computes prev_entry_hash (GENESIS for the first ever item) and entry_hash via app/audit.py per C1, and stores both fields inside the event item appended to the RingBuffer; add the GET /events?audit=true handler per C3 (returns {'audit_chain': [{event_id, prev_entry_hash, entry_hash}, ...]} in storage order, [] when empty); strip prev_entry_hash/entry_hash from every C2 response (list_events output) so the frozen response shape stays byte-exact; API-level tests in tests/test_audit.py cover the audit query shape and the no-audit-leak guarantee on C2 responses.
